titulo: Conjugate caber and saber in the simple future
subtitulo: Twins in the future: both lose their e. Cabré, sabré; cabremos, sabremos.
regla: Caber and saber drop the e of the infinitive to make the stems cabr- and sabr-, then add -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -án.

bloques.texto: **Saber** (_to know_) and **caber** (_to fit_) are irregular in the **simple future** (**futuro imperfecto**) for the same reason: the **e** of the infinitive disappears. The endings are the regular ones.
**Caber** is used with **en** for the place: **caber en el carro**. When it's things that fit, the verb agrees with them: **tres tablas cabrán en la camioneta**.
Tip: they rhyme, so learn them as a pair: **sabré y cabré**, **sabrás y cabrás**.

lista.en: Do you think I'll fit in that wetsuit?

lista.es: Con tantas cosas no ==cabrás== en la cochera.
lista.en: With so many things you won't fit in the garage.

lista.es: Tranquilo, la tabla grande ==cabrá== en la camioneta.
lista.en: Don't worry, the big board will fit in the truck.
We won't all fit in the Tsuru.

lista.es: No ==sabré== el resultado del torneo hasta mañana.
lista.en: I won't know the tournament result until tomorrow.
Holden will know the truth very soon.

lista.es: ¿==Sabremos== si hay olas antes de salir?
lista.en: Will we know if there are waves before we leave?

lista.es: Ustedes ==sabrán== cómo hablar con el cliente.
lista.en: You'll know how to talk to the customer.

lista.nota: **Quepo** is the present **yo** of **caber**. In the future, the stem is **cabr-**.

filas.t: Las tablas no cabrá en el carro.
Las tablas no cabrán en el carro.

lista.nota: The things that fit are the subject: plural things, plural verb.

secciones.titulo: Other verbs that drop the e

lista.texto: Their preterite is irregular too: [[5253|caber and saber in the preterite]].
The endings are the same as for every verb in the future: [[5155|regular verbs in the simple future]].
In the present only **yo** is odd (**sé**; **caber** has **quepo**): [[5590|saber in the present]].
The conditional uses the very same stem, with **-ía** endings: [[5915|the conditional]].
The future also guesses about right now: [[5060|the future for probability]].
The future of **haber** + participle: [[5066|irregular verbs in the future perfect]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.r: No cabremos todos en el elevador.

lista.p: In Spanish: _You (tú) will know my answer tomorrow._
Which one? **Tres kilos de limones caberán en la bolsa** or **Tres kilos de limones cabrán en la bolsa**.
lista.r: Tres kilos de limones cabrán en la bolsa.
lista.nota: Stem **cabr-**, and plural because the lemons are the subject.
